title: Fisher Flow Matching for Generative Modeling over Discrete Data
tldr_zh: 把离散类别分布嵌入 Fisher-Rao 球面正象限做流匹配，用黎曼 OT 耦合改善训练，在 DNA 与 LM1B 上优于离散扩散基线
tldr_en: Embeds categorical distributions into Fisher-Rao sphere positive orthant for flow matching with Riemannian OT coupling, outperforming discrete diffusion baselines on DNA and LM1B
